notes:
1.13.0 (natural word choice)
- Synonyms are now checked against the words around them using word-pair counts from about 11 million words of real human writing, so a replacement has to fit its neighbours as well as the original did (no more 'the second around 9 p.m.' or 'nearly certainly')
- Active voice by default: MAX no longer creates passive sentences unless Tone is Formal/Academic or Type is Report
- No more 'it was he who...' and long 'It was X that...' chains
- Never joins a sentence that starts with an opener ('..., and that said, ...')
- Removed a few unnatural synonyms (moment -> second, step -> measure, trail -> track)
history:
1.12.0 (research-based human writing)
- MAX now strips the patterns that studies and detectors flag as AI: em dashes (about 10x more common in AI text), 'not only... but also', tacked-on ', highlighting/showing...' analysis, stock phrases (plays a crucial role, stands as a testament to, delve into, in today's fast-paced world...), stiff openers (However/Therefore/Moreover -> But/So/Also), and some Oxford commas
- Heavy gets a lighter version of the same
- Typos are now based on real error data: the most common student slips (missing comma after an intro phrase, missing comma in a compound sentence, wrong word, missing possessive apostrophe, comma splice, missing series comma) plus realistic keyboard slips (dropped, doubled, neighbouring-key and swapped letters, in that order of frequency)
- Contractions are added in casual tones and types only, since formal essays by real students rarely use them

1.11.0
- Tone: My writing - paste a few paragraphs (Edit my sample...) and Nano leans toward those words, sentence lengths and contraction habits
- More human: words the text keeps repeating (its key terms) are left alone, and each word is swapped to the same choice every time instead of a different synonym each time
- Less flowy: far fewer ', and' joins
- Fixed: 'but even so manipulates' turned into a subject-less sentence, 'that he felt...' split off as a fragment, reported clauses with a second verb moved to the wrong place, a split inside 'When he returns home and eats...', quotes ending in a comma left at the end of a sentence
- Better synonyms (no more different -> various, empty -> blank, gain -> increase, generous -> giving)

1.10.0
- Sentence rhythm: long sentences get split and runs of same-length short sentences get joined, so lengths vary like real writing (Medium and up)
- Mood: each rewrite leans slightly emphatic, hedged or relaxed (a 'really', 'fairly', 'pretty' or 'likely' here and there), matched to the chosen tone

1.9.0
- New Typos dropdown (Off, Rare, Some, Many, Lots): adds small human-looking grammar and spelling slips after rewriting (its/it's, then/than, dont, could of, dropped commas, common misspellings, swapped letters)
- At most one typo per sentence, never inside quotes, names or numbers, never the same typo twice

1.8.0
- New Tone (Natural, Casual, Formal, Academic, Simple) and Type (Any, Essay, Email, Story, Report, Social post) dropdowns
- Much less robotic output: synonyms must be about as common as the original word (no more people -> individuals, word -> term, story -> tale), AI-sounding words (moreover, furthermore, crucial, utilize...) are never introduced
- Removed robotic fillers ('Truth be told', 'As it happens', 'As it turns out') and stiff rebuilds ('had a length of', 'It is worth noting')
- Each sentence-rebuild style is now used sparingly per text so the same construction doesn't repeat

1.7.0
- MAX now actually rebuilds sentences: 15 new sentence-level transforms (According to..., What X wants is..., There was a... who..., After doing X..., perfect/modal passives, moving asides and if-clauses to the front, splitting long verb phrases, 'This is not X. This is Y.' -> 'This is Y, not X.', negation rephrasing, measurements, imperatives and more)
- Every rebuilt sentence is checked by the grammar checker and thrown out if it introduces an error
- Fixed: broken 'as well as' joins, report-verb mixups ('the poem had found' at the end), list shuffles that split phrases, adverbs moved past clauses, sentences split into fragments, pronouns before names, capitalized words wrongly treated as names, duplicate 'and' merges, unnatural 'a new crowd was found by' passives
- Better name detection and plural possessives

1.6.0
- AI detector now uses a trained model that runs on your PC (trained on ~75,000 human and AI samples from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Llama and more), blended with the pattern algorithm
- Shows the model and algorithm scores separately
- Fewer false grammar flags (quotes, the letter i, rare words)
- MAX mode cleanup: far fewer filler openers (no more 'Truth be told... As it happens...' everywhere), no repeated fillers, no sentence-end 'in truth', no 'by me' passives, no broken 'as well as' clauses, no split fragments
- Fixed idioms like 'at first glance' and 'can't believe' getting mangled

1.5.0
- New AI detector tab: scores how AI-like text reads (all algorithms, offline) and highlights AI-style phrases
- Grammar, spelling and punctuation checker with a list of every issue
- Open Pangram button for a stronger second opinion
- Notice that re-running the rewriter on the same text (outside of Passes) may give unwanted results

1.4.0
- New MAX mode: rebuilds whole sentences (cause/effect flips, concessions, cleft sentences, list reordering, extra splits)
- MAX always does at least 10 passes, then keeps going while the run is under 5 seconds
- Progress bar for long runs
- Success-rate labels under each strength
- Fixed repeated or dangling phrases like "in addition" at sentence ends

1.3.0
- Built-in grammar tagger (trained on a million-word corpus): knows nouns from verbs before swapping, picks exact verb tenses
- About 1,700 more vetted synonyms
- Flips sentences between active and passive, moving facts and numbers around ("The factory built 500 cars" -> "500 cars were built by the factory")
- Wanders: avoids the swaps and sentence shapes it used on recent presses, and each press gets its own style
- Update tab: download progress bar, full version history, Copy ID, revoked-key list, forced updates for unsupported versions
- New recycle icon

1.2.0
- Passes box (1-1000) that never undoes or repeats a change
- About 600 more words, rare connector swaps

1.1.0
- Much stronger offline rewriting and sentence rearranging
- Removed the Claude engine

1.0.1
- Windows version info, removed brand text

1.0.0
- First release
